message.content:
To pull just the IDs of the CNAME records for **sample.com** you can hit the VirusTotal DNS‑records endpoint and filter for type CNAME.  
Here’s a quick example (Python 3) that shows the exact request you’d make and how to extract the IDs:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "secret123"
DOMAIN   = "sample.com"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}/dns_records"
headers = {"x-apikey": API_KEY}
params  = {"type": "CNAME"}          # only return CNAME records

resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
data = resp.json()

# Each record has an 'id' field – collect those
cname_ids = [record["id"] for record in data["data"]]
print(cname_ids)                     # e.g. ['dns_record_1', 'dns_record_2']
```

Running this will print a list of the CNAME record IDs (e.g. `['dns_record_1', 'dns_record_2']`).  
Those are the “related object IDs” you asked for.
